data.name: Misrar
data.gender_notes: Misrar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who provides shelter and protection. The name Misrar carries the meaning “Protector” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Misrar usually hope their child will grow to embody protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a protector in this world and the next
data.etymology: Misrar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Misrar total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: مِصرار
in_arabic.long_meaning: أَحرف مِصرار مُشتقَةٌ مِن أَحرف مِسَر، وَهِيَ مِضْمار مِن الَّتي تُشيرُ إِلَى الرِزقِ وَالرِضوانِ، وَكُلُّ رِضى بِالرِزقِ يُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ، وَكَهذا مَوضِع مِصرار مِن أَصلِهِ مِصراً وَمَعناهُ قَريبٌ لِماذَا قَد نَبَت عَنَ المُصرى، وَمُصرار مِصرار مِنهُ، وَالمُصرى فِعل مَنصوب مِن مَصَرّ، وَهُوَ مَضارع مِن مَصَرّ إِلى مُصَرّ، وَمَصَرّ يَدُلُّ عَلى مُصارَةِ الأَمرِ وَتَصَرُّفِهِ، وَهَكَذا نُطقَ المُصرارِ مِصرارَ مِنهُ، وَمَعناهُ قَريبٌ لِماذَا قَد نَبَت عَنَ المُصرى، وَمُصرار مِصرار مِنهُ، وَكُلُّ هَذا تَصوِيف لِلَّذي يُقَرِّب مِنَ الرِزقِ وَيُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ، وَهَذا مِنَ الرِزقِ الَّذي يُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ، وَهَذا مِنَ الرِزقِ الَّذي يَستَمِعُ إِلى مُصارَةِ الأَمرِ وَتَصَرُّفِهِ، وَهَكَذا نُطقَ المُصرارِ مِصرارَ مِنهُ، وَمَعناهُ قَريبٌ لِماذَا قَد نَبَت عَنَ المُصرى، وَمُصرار مِصرار مِنهُ، وَكُلُّ هَذا تَصوِيف لِلَّذي يُقَرِّب مِنَ الرِزقِ وَيُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ، وَهَذا مِنَ الرِزقِ الَّذي يُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ، وَهَذا مِنَ الرِزقِ الَّذي يَستَمِعُ إِلى مُصارَةِ الأَمرِ وَتَصَرُّفِهِ، وَهَكَذا نُطقَ المُصرارِ مِصرارَ مِنهُ، وَمَعناهُ قَريبٌ لِماذَا قَد نَبَت عَنَ المُصرى، وَمُصرار مِصرار مِنهُ، وَكُلُّ هَذا تَصوِيف لِلَّذي يُقَرِّب مِنَ الرِزقِ وَيُؤَدِّي لِلمُعطى أَن يَكونَ مُضمارًا لِمَن أَرضاهُ

in_urdu.name: مِصرار
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ تعالیٰ نے اسے رزق سے واقف کیا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مصرار کے نام کے اشتقاق سے معلوم ہوتا ہے کہ یہ نام رزق و رضا کا مظہر ہے، رزق کی پہلے کے معنی میں ہے کہ جو اللہ تعالیٰ نے کسی کو رزق دیا ہو، اور رضا کے معنی میں ہے کہ اللہ تعالیٰ نے کسی کو رضا دی ہو، جب کوئی شخص اللہ تعالیٰ کا فضل حاصل کرتا ہے تو اللہ تعالیٰ اس کو اس کے رزق میں بڑھا دیتا ہے، اور جب کوئی شخص اللہ تعالیٰ کا فضل حاصل کرتا ہے تو اللہ تعالیٰ اس کو اس کے رزق میں بڑھا دیتا ہے، اور جب کوئی شخص اللہ تعالیٰ کا فضل حاصل کرتا ہے تو اللہ تعالیٰ اس کو اس کے رزق میں بڑھا دیتا ہے

in_english.name: Misrar
in_english.meaning: God made him aware of the blessings and pleased him
in_english.long_meaning: The name Misrar has its roots in the Arabic word 'misar', which means 'to be aware of the blessings' or 'to be pleased with the blessings'. In Islamic tradition, being aware of the blessings and pleased with them is a sign of gratitude and contentment. Misrar is a name that signifies the individual's spiritual growth and awareness of the blessings of life. It is a name that conveys the idea of being in a state of peace and contentment, where one is grateful for the blessings they have received and is aware of the blessings they have yet to receive.

data.cultural_impact: The name Misrar holds great cultural significance to the Islamic community, as it reflects the ideals of hospitality, kindness, and generosity, which are deeply rooted in Islamic teachings. Misr or Egypt, the land of two rivers, was historically known as a center for trade and a hub for diverse cultures, where people from different backgrounds found refuge. The name Misrar could be a reminder of the warm and welcoming spirit of these historic centers and the importance of providing shelter and protection to those in need.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Misrar has deep spiritual significance for Muslims as it embodies the Quranic virtues of kindness, compassion, and generosity, which are necessary for creating strong communities and leading a purposeful life. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) said, "None of you will believe until you love me more than your fathers, your children, and your people". This hadith emphasizes the importance of extending love and care to others beyond our immediate family and kinship. The name Misrar can serve as a reminder to always strive to be a source of comfort and a shelter for those in need, reflecting the higher purpose of human existence. Additionally, the spiritual dimension of the name is linked to the idea of seeking refuge in Allah, who provides shelter and protection to all of His creation. The name Misrar can serve as a reminder to seek refuge in God and extend kindness and protection to others as a manifestation of our faith.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Protector" symbolizes The one who provides shelter and protection. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Misrar serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of protector.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference:
Ibn Battuta describes Misr as a major religious center and a place of pilgrimage for Muslims. He mentions Sheikh Qushari's famous mosque and mausoleum which was a major attraction for travelers.
Reference: Ibn Battuta, Travels in Asia and Africa.
Time period: 1304-1377 AD.
Context: During the Mamluk Sultanate in Egypt.
